source: This is why “ZXNAME0000XZ model” should not be read as “every operation executes in ZXNAME0001XZ.” Layer normalization, softmax, reductions, accumulations, and unsupported operations can remain ZXNAME0002XZ/ZXNAME0003XZ/ZXNAME0004XZ depending on the recipe.
zh: 这就是为什么“ZXNAME0000XZ模型”不应该被理解为“每个操作都在ZXNAME0001XZ中执行”。层归一化、softmax、缩减、累积和不支持的操作可以保留 ZXNAME0002XZ/ZXNAME0003XZ/ZXNAME0004XZ，具体取决于配方。
